headline: Police ASI withdrew from station after claiming he joined police to take bribes
summary: Assistant Sub-Inspector Mohammad Elias Hosain was removed from Chunarughat station in Habiganj after a video surfaced of him admitting to taking bribes.
details: Assistant Sub-Inspector (ASI) Mohammad Elias Hosain of Chunarughat Police Station in Habiganj has been withdrawn from his post following a controversial video.
caption:
“I put on this uniform with bribe money, and for the purpose of taking bribes.”

Assistant Sub-Inspector (ASI) Mohammad Elias Hosain of Chunarughat Police Station in Habiganj has been withdrawn from his post following a controversial video.

Source: Prothom Alo, Jamuna TV

headline_marked: Murder suspect [[accused escapes from Dhaka court]] for second time
headline: Murder suspect accused escapes from Dhaka court for second time
summary: Shariful Islam Shafiq managed to unlock his handcuffs and flee from the Chief Metropolitan Magistrate Court on Tuesday afternoon.
details: A murder suspect named Shariful Islam Shafiq escaped from the Chief Metropolitan Magistrate (CMM) Court in Dhaka on Tuesday afternoon.
The accused had his handcuffs attached to the dock of the courtroom. He managed to unlock the handcuffs and flee from the court premises.

This is the second time the suspect has escaped from custody. On June 19 last year, he escaped from the Metropolitan Sessions Judge Court while being transported to the lock-up after assaulting police officers.
Following his first escape, the Kotwali Police Station filed a case against him, and he was later rearrested by the police.
He was brought to court on Tuesday for a witness testimony session in the case regarding his previous escape. However, the testimony did not take place as the witness failed to appear.
The suspect took advantage of the situation and escaped from the court dock after unlocking his handcuffs.
caption:
He escaped once before by assaulting police. Now, he's gone again—this time by unlocking his handcuffs in open court.

A murder suspect named Shariful Islam Shafiq escaped from the Chief Metropolitan Magistrate (CMM) Court in Dhaka on Tuesday afternoon.

The accused had his handcuffs attached to the dock of the courtroom. He managed to unlock the handcuffs and flee from the court premises.

This is the second time the suspect has escaped from custody. On June 19 last year, he escaped from the Metropolitan Sessions Judge Court while being transported to the lock-up after assaulting police officers.

Following his first escape, the Kotwali Police Station filed a case against him, and he was later rearrested by the police.

He was brought to court on Tuesday for a witness testimony session in the case regarding his previous escape. However, the testimony did not take place as the witness failed to appear.

The suspect took advantage of the situation and escaped from the court dock after unlocking his handcuffs.

#Bangladesh #Dhaka #CourtEscape #CrimeNews #JusticeSystem

Source: Jamuna TV, Prothom Alo
